lambda_constant_table.input_validation: Retained summary/status/model-manifest bytes matched independent audit; model-manifest bytes matched pre-evaluation freeze.
lambda_constant_table.rounding: Exact counts and decimal half-up for percentages; ceiling for the stated refinement bound.

directional_frontier_figure.scope: Analytic inequalities for gamma=K2=1; no random observations or financial study.

financial_sealed_snapshot.scope: All requested twenty markets fully replayed and byte-bound; separate interim report with no manuscript changes.

final_analysis_freeze.scope: The five frozen utility contrasts reproduce the retained twenty-market pilot table. No new markets, final outcomes or independent pathwise replay.

realized_scalar_utility.scope: Same 4096 saved paths/law, endpoint 65536; no new scientific draws, all-path score replay or stopped-benefit estimate.

automatic_continuation.scope: Process/whole-plan/source/completion gates and immutable reporting; no scientific source change or new market count.

uniform_family_bound.scope: Report-only checks in a temporary copy; deterministic analytic ceiling, no new paths or observed-power estimate.

cash_park_prior_art.scope: Attribution and assumption mapping only; no new observations or altered scientific methodology. The 286 deterministic theory checks pass with updated proof-source provenance; generated scalar report text is unchanged.

geometric_bet_extension.scope: 102 separate finite deterministic checks, not another Monte Carlo experiment or proof of the almost-sure statements. Existing numerical manuscript tables and curves unchanged.

independent_event_reporting.scope: Independent JSON-to-report transcription, exact cohort/deployment membership, all 1/3/5-year event and market-specific rates, registry consistency and four per-market decision metrics. No new market, optimizer or score replay; stable-event adjudication and underlying conditional utility are not recomputed. Event populations remain method-specific and do not identify causal cross-method delay or waiting-cost effects. Serialized gain-field identity uses an explicit ten-decimal serialization bound, not the event-positivity tolerance or machine precision.

independent_event_adjudication.scope: Independent batch reconstruction of all stable and unstable event labels, confirmations, delays and closure reasons from ordered annual conditional-score arrays, annual eligibility/selection flags, closure logs and one-block ghost continuations. Includes the separate JSON/CSV aggregation audit. No DGP resimulation, optimizer rerun or new market; the stored conditional-score formulas and selector decisions rely on their separately recorded arithmetic replay. Method-specific event populations do not identify causal cross-method delay or waiting-cost effects.
